query: WITH entities AS (SELECT created_at, id FROM skills WHERE (NOT $1 OR project_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $2) AND (NOT $3 OR space_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $4) AND COALESCE(name = $5, $5 IS NULL) AND (COALESCE((created_at, id) < ($8, $7), $7 IS NULL)) AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $6) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $9 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at FROM entities i JOIN skill_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.created_at desc, i.id desc, i.id, e.sequence
